title: Size bound for a fan-in-two circuit
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables, there is a directed acyclic circuit with those inputs and a valid output vertex that computes the function on every assignment. Each gate has at most two inputs, has no repeated input index, and every NOT gate has exactly one input; the circuit size, counting the input vertices and gates, is at most $n2^n+2n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative integer number of variables
A Boolean function on assignments to those variables
